title: Tool error body
description: The JSON body of every MCP tool result with isError: true, and of the local pages' JSON errors (PERSON steps only there). Every error tells the agent what to do next (nextSteps, first step first) and, when the person must know or act, what to show them (personMessage, verbatim). See CONTRACT.md, Error codes and Next steps.

reason.description: Which case of the code; set for every code with more than one case. The reasons per code are in api/mcp/errors/next-steps.json and CONTRACT.md, Next steps per code.

message.description: One line for the agent. May repeat the steps in prose.

sqlState.description: Set when Postgres raised the error.

docsUrl.description: The code's section on the public docs: https://docs.basaltvault.app/reference/errors/# followed by the code in lowercase with underscores as hyphens. The server adds it to every tool error.

errorId.description: UNAVAILABLE and INTERNAL: the id the engine logged the error under, for the person to find the log line.

personMessage.description: The message the agent shows the person verbatim, keeping its line breaks; each URL on a line of its own (planned, M3.5), at most 500 characters not counting URL lines (CONTRACT.md, Showing links). Set whenever the person must know or act. For APPROVAL_REQUIRED it equals approval.personMessage.

links.description: The URLs of personMessage with labels, in order; present exactly when personMessage holds a URL.

approval.description: APPROVAL_REQUIRED only: the held write (CONTRACT.md, Error codes).

approvalUrl.description: The approval page's link. Absent only with reason REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: no link this engine has can carry the request (CONTRACT.md, Large values).

requestFile.description: Only with a hash link in approvalUrl: the request to send the person as a file or text blocks (CONTRACT.md, The request file and pasted blocks).
